# Index

Inline [a file](other.md), [a directory](sub), [the parent](../),
[from the root](/docs/other.md#top) and [with a query](other.md?plain=1).

Reference-style: [full][other], [collapsed][], [shortcut].

Encoded: [space](my%20file.md), [hash in the name](a%23b.md), [bad escape](100%.md).

Broken: [missing](nope.md), [wrong case](Other.md),
[outside](../../elsewhere.md), [ignored file](../build/out.txt),
[ignored directory](../build).

External: [web](https://example.com/x.md), [mail](mailto:a@example.com),
<https://example.com/auto>, <me@example.com>, [fragment](#index).

[other]: other.md
[collapsed]: ./sub/
[shortcut]: <my file.md>
